QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_17

question.text: Under SEBI's framework, from which point in a Category I/II AIF Scheme's life is reporting to the Benchmarking Agency mandatory?

answer.text: From the date of SEBI registration grant.
From the date of Final Close.
From completion of 1 year from the date of First Close.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Chapter 7.6 and Box 7.3(b): 'AIFs/Schemes that have completed at least one year from First Close, shall provide all the necessary information/data to the Benchmarking Agencies.' **The Trap:** SEBI registration (A) is earlier and no fund-data exists yet. Final Close (B) can be up to 12 months after First Close and is not the trigger. DPI > 1 (D) can take 5-7 years — benchmarking must start much earlier. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests the same 1-year-from-First-Close trigger. XIX-A distributor exam highlights that LP marketing material must cite the Benchmark Report once reporting starts. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** At First Close + 11 months, trigger an internal 'benchmark-readiness' checklist: valuation agency MoU, cash-flow dataset, investee-company audited data clause in SHAs. Missing even one item delays the first Benchmark Report.
